annotations.title: Give an agent flow a knowledge base to search

description: Attaches a knowledge base to an AGENT flow's draft, the same way picking it in the agent editor does: a docs knowledge base becomes a search tool the model calls when a question needs it; a tabular one also puts its tables in the prompt and adds a query tool. The flow needs a system prompt (scaffold it with one). Attaching one that's already there changes nothing. Do it BEFORE workbench_flows_publish: a published version is what interfaces and schedules run, so attach, try it with workbench_flows_run, then publish — and if something already pins an older version (an interface grant), re-grant the new version. Tell the model in its system prompt what the knowledge base holds and when to search it. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

flowId.description: The agent flow, from workbench_flows_scaffold or workbench_flows_list.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The knowledge base id, from workbench_kb_create or workbench_kb_list.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_flows_attach_knowledge_base
